title: Internal: Downgrading a Credit Card to a No-Annual-Fee Card
summary: This document explains when and how to downgrade a credit card to a no-annual-fee option to address annual fee concerns. It covers eligible downgrade scenarios (<2 years, or explicit request), allowed target cards (Bronze Rewards Card / Business Bronze Rewards Card), downgrade steps, required tool downgrade_credit_card_3847 arguments, what is preserved (history, credit line, account number), rewards/benefit changes, immediate effect, card delivery timing (several business days), and potential prorated annual fee refund if paid recently.
faqs: When should we offer a downgrade to a no-annual-fee card due to annual fee concerns?
Which no-annual-fee cards can a customer downgrade to (Bronze vs Business Bronze)?
Can we downgrade a personal card to a business card (or vice versa)?
What happens to the customer’s account history, credit line, account number, and unredeemed rewards points after a downgrade?
What are the steps and tool (downgrade_credit_card_3847) arguments required to process the downgrade?
When does the downgrade take effect, how long until the new card arrives, and is there a prorated annual fee refund?
